stage: WebGL 2 fallback, prompt 3: smoke demo + exact-ZIP browser/package acceptance
scope: Integrate the WebGL 2 backend + Auto fallback into apps/smoke through the public rendering API, and extend the exact-ZIP browser QA matrix. Software GPU only (SwiftShader); hardware and hosted/iframe-on-HTTPS acceptance remain separate gates.

smoke_integration.renderer: apps/smoke/renderer_web.cpp rewritten to drive only the public rendering API (CreateShader/CreateUniform/CreatePipeline/UpdateUniform/DrawFullscreen) with the SDK-generated generic shader; no RHI-private probe headers or backend handles. Animates identically on WebGPU and WebGL 2.
smoke_integration.shader: apps/smoke/shaders/smoke.slang compiled by ludus_compile_shader to SPIR-V (Vulkan), WGSL (WebGPU) and GLSL ES 3.00 (WebGL 2). Vertex uses SV_VulkanVertexID. Draws a moving orange marker on a pulsing background.
smoke_integration.input_fix: application.cpp recognizes any browser backend (WebGPU or WebGL2), not only Backend::WebGPU, for browser input/framebuffer handling.
smoke_integration.selection_api: Application::Start(BackendSelection = Auto); main_web.cpp reads ?backend=auto|webgpu|webgl2 for diagnosis.
smoke_integration.ui: shell.html reserves a status region that cannot be covered by canvas or controls; Stop/Fullscreen inactive until playing; Restart available when stopped/failed. Player text concise; backend and per-attempt errors are data-* QA metadata only. An expected Auto fallback reads as Ready, not a failure. Both-unavailable shows a concise accessible final error naming neither API as the sole cause.

canvas_ownership.problem: A canvas that acquired a 'webgpu' context cannot acquire 'webgl2'; the WebGPU probe and surface committed the real canvas, blocking the WebGL 2 fallback.
fixes: WebGPU availability is probed on a throwaway canvas (CanCreateSurface), never committing the real canvas during probing.

Platform owns canvas replacement: browser::ReplaceCanvas(selector) swaps the committed canvas for a fresh node with the same id/attributes/CSS/DOM position and rebinds all listeners/observer/focus. The dispatcher calls it before a WebGL 2 fallback attempt.

Attempt generation isolation: internal::Reissue advances the session token before the WebGL 2 attempt so a late WebGPU device-lost/error callback (old token) is dropped and cannot kill the active WebGL 2 session.

package.notes: Shaders are embedded in the wasm; the SPIR-V->GLSL ES translator (SPIRV-Cross, Apache-2.0) is a build-time host tool and does not ship, but its notice travels in licenses/. build-info.json records web, shader and SPIRV-Cross toolchains, payload hashes and the single-threaded memory policy. Relative-asset and wasm memory-policy validation pass; the archive self-verifies by CRC and extraction.
